notes: M20 Barkhide Troll, printed: '{1}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: This creature gains hexproof until end of turn.' The counter is removed as a cost, when the ability is activated (CR 602.2b), so it is gone before anyone can respond: while the ability waits on the stack the Troll is already a 2/2 with no hexproof, the opponent's Shock can target it, and its two damage kill it. Had the counter stayed until resolution the Troll would be 3/3 and live.
